objective: Evidence-based current architecture and repository selection across the native coding/research foundation and US-equities north star, with justified native acceptances and GitHub publication.

user_direction.eventual_broker: Alpaca paper, with future separately accepted live capability
user_direction.grand_dashboard: Show all workflow actions, decisions/progress, workers, gates, native evidence and simulation/paper/live readiness using the existing observability stack.
user_direction.current_priority: Historical simulation/backtesting now; user will configure dedicated paper credentials locally later.

scope.paper_execution_state: User chose dedicated research paper account and will configure credentials locally; current priority is historical simulation/backtests, no orders submitted.

requirements: Native Codex/Claude clients and official SDKs
Context/tool-output selection and architectural token efficiency
Shared memory lifecycle and compounding learning
Embedding/model identity, version and serving compatibility
Agent skills, community guidance and orchestration
Worker hosting, interruption, resource and process lifecycle
Research factors, historical extreme movers and all-candidate ledgers
Backtest engines, execution realism and statistical evaluation
Market-state selection and strategy/portfolio transition semantics
Alpaca SDK, paper readiness, rate limits and data entitlements
Grand decision/progress dashboard with explicit live/recorded/unknown evidence states

required: Primary repository/source identity and dated revision
Selected implementation and upstream test evidence for finalists
Native API/command compatibility and failure semantics
Information timing and reproducibility where relevant
Measured advantage before replacing an accepted incumbent
quality_contract.selection: Retain the smallest coherent set that meets requirements. Compare challengers against incumbents and preserve rejected/deferred candidates.

waves.purpose: Refresh public-star identity delta; inspect meaningful gaps and incumbent/challenger sources.
Challenge initial choices using beyond-star/awesome-list primary references and unresolved capability evidence.
Run only justified native improvements: isolated memory lifecycle, exact-time replay and transient supervision, plus one bounded hosted research review.
Review results, update typed decisions/requirements/evidence, verify integrity and exact-commit GitHub CI.

convergence_criteria: Every listed requirement maps to a current incumbent, conditional alternative, or explicit unmet gate.
Every public-star identity is accounted for in the refreshed ledger; deep review depth is stated separately from enumeration.
Both source rounds retain candidate decisions and explain whether additional candidates add demonstrated value.
Justified native acceptance attempts retain commands, results, failure recovery and limitations, without silently retrying unchanged account errors.
Selected hosts and models have only their actual native evidence credited; macOS/other-host gaps remain explicit.
No supported review finding remains unresolved in integrated artifacts.
GitHub contains current references, source/command manifests, validation results and continuation instructions.
stopping_rule: Converge the examined requirement/candidate sets when a further bounded challenge round adds no justified adoption or unaddressed architecture responsibility. If it does, evaluate the new candidate rather than declaring saturation. External data/account/host gates remain explicit and are not inferred closed.
continuation: Start with coverage.md and one explicit remaining gate. Current priority is accepted historical/PIT data and held-out catalyst/extreme-mover research, not repeated fixed stress runs. Paper setup is user-deferred; keep dedicated account credentials local. Refresh only changed candidates and preserve commands, failures, review and usage scope.

results.scope: Bounded examined candidates and requirements, not a definitive universal ranking.
results.publication_verification: Repository validators, content hashes, secret scan and exact published-commit GitHub CI are required; check the recorded task handoff and Actions for final commit outcome.

lane_contract.simulation: Synthetic/historical stress tests may examine aggressive leverage with explicit funding, liquidity, margin and liquidation assumptions; simulated feasibility does not prove broker support.
lane_contract.paper: Use an explicitly selected paper endpoint/account. Preserve existing positions unless the user selects isolated disposable scope. Apply actual account/asset/session constraints, risk caps, order journal and reconciliation. Aggression is a frozen experiment parameter, not unlimited leverage.
lane_contract.live: Future separate promotion with actual account/risk/operating readiness and explicit user decision. No automatic policy promotion from a winning simulation/paper run.
